name: Qwen3.8-27B (Unsloth NVFP4)
notes: Verified on one DGX Spark 2026-10-09: starts in 5 min (weights 20.4 GiB, loaded in 2.5 min), 1.76M tokens of KV cache at 256k context (6.73x) with 0.70, ~11 tok/s for one stream with thinking off, tool calls work, correct English answers. In a short Swedish test it named the wrong lake (Vättern for Vänern), so check facts in Swedish. Dense 27B, Unsloth's recommended all-round model for DGX Spark, and the dense alternative to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on one Spark: newer generation and all 27B parameters active, but about a quarter of its speed; with two Sparks it is split across both. Compressed-tensors NVFP4 on the official vLLM image (0.29.1), no Ray. Thinking is on by default; turn it off per request with chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false}.
